note: 2026-11-14 #2282 bare doorways. core-hall@2 is a new immutable revision of core-hall@1 (whose bytes are unchanged): make.args.bareDoors lets an outside door in its explicit plan say leaf: false, and the hall then draws no leaf in that opening, so a door thing set in it (core/door@2 in the Eden 2026 classroom) is the door. Walls, colliders and openings are byte-identical to core-hall@1 for the same params (packages/generators/src/building.test.ts). A narrow K=2 run (`conformance.mjs --k 2 --filter core-hall@`) placed, baked, furnished and rendered all samples of core-hall@1 and core-hall@2 with no findings, so nothing is pinned. A wider K=32 run of the same filter (not the gate's K) showed gallery triangles over 6000 at large random sizes for both revisions, and for core-hall@2 an auto stair crossing a wall (place: architecture, stairs.outside-room) at random[5] and random[19]; at those two samples the layout checks are identical with and without bareDoors, so they come from the hall's random params, not from this change. No budgets, samples or gap checks were relaxed, and the rendering-gap list is unchanged.
